name: camera
description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Rounded rectangular body uses the Folder corner rhythm, straight shoulder ledges and a raised housing. A single horizontal housing-edge at y=6.8 joins the shoulders beneath the raised cap; the shared span is drawn once. The indicator is a circular stroke mark centered at 17.9,9.5 with radius 0.15; it stays a solid circular dot across the Thin/Regular/Bold presets. Circular lens stays circular; its center is lowered to y=13.2. Source bounds x=3..21 and y=4.1..19.9 balance opposite margins. Review study; not owner-approved.
